name: Baked Gremolata-Crusted Tofu with Potatoes, Zucchini, Peppers & Olives

instructions.primary_message: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Place oven racks in the upper, middle, and lower positions.

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb new potatoes
3 medium zucchini squash
3 red bell peppers
1 ½ lemons
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Quarter potatoes and divide between two additional large baking sheets.
Peel, halve, and large dice onions. Add to the baking sheets with the potatoes, then drizzle with oil and season with spices. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets on lower racks of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until the potatoes start to soften, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, trim and large dice zucchini. Trim, seed, and large dice bell peppers. Place both in a large bowl and set aside.
Zest lemons into a small bowl. Juice lemons into another small bowl.

Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the lemon zest and half to the bowl with the lemon juice. (Set the bowl with the lemon juice aside for later use.)
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon zest along with bread crumbs, oil, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the gremolata topping.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut the tofu planks in half crosswise. Wipe the baking sheet dry with paper towels, then coat with a thin layer of oil. Return tofu to the baking sheet, sprinkle with gremolata topping, and press gently to adhere. Set aside.
Once the potatoes have softened, remove from oven. Add zucchini and bell pepper to the baking sheets, stir to combine, and spread out in an even layer.

Return veggies to the oven, along with the tofu, placing tofu on the upper rack. Continue to bake until veggies are fork-tender, gremolata topping is golden brown, and tofu is warmed through, 10-12 minutes more.
Meanwhile, add yogurt, mayo, and salt to the bowl with the lemon juice. Stir to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
¼ cup mayonnaise
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: When the tofu is done, remove baking sheets from the oven. Add olives to the veggies and stir to combine.
Divide tofu and veggies between plates or bowls. Serve with sauce on the side and enjoy!
